entries.title: Your go-ahead without the change story now reaches the merge
entries.body: When you tell your first mate a task may go ahead without its change story, the merge now goes through as well, instead of stopping to ask for a story you already set aside. Passing checks, your merge approval and the rules where your project lives still apply.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes; the merge now proceeds where it used to stop with a refusal.
